decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter was presented on the home page as a flagship of the firm's direction and is integral to its track system, so the visible commitment and investment make management inclined to keep it.

This LED luminaire line sits close to the core offer and has several models, but it was only mentioned on the site and carries little public commitment, so it is a plausible candidate for portfolio pruning four years after launch; on balance it is kept.
The home automation server box builds on the firm's stated home automation direction and requires ongoing support for installed customers, which justifies persisting despite modest visibility.

The luminaire family had its own dedicated page, a moderate visible commitment, and fits the established premium offer, so dropping it would write off investment that management still wants to justify.
